articles.title: Ötzi the Iceman’s Ancient Yeast Bakes a Tasty Loaf, and Google’s 64-Million-Mosquito Plan
articles.summary: Researchers revived 5,300-year-old yeast from Ötzi the Iceman and baked sourdough — calling it 'very very good.' Meanwhile, Google seeks EPA approval to release 64 million bacteria-infected male mosquitoes to curb disease.

articles.title: The Peculiar Problem of Pinning Down Gravity’s Strength
articles.summary: Despite decades of experiments, scientists still can’t agree on gravity’s exact strength. One physicist says measuring it is like weighing 7 human cells — and the culprit might be psychology, not physics.
